scene.title: NEON CORRIDOR EVASION
scene.purpose: Deliver high-tension kinetic pacing without erratic camera work. Grounded cyberpunk atmosphere where physical weight and environmental resistance are paramount.
scene.emotional_destination: Hyper-focused survival, relentless forward momentum, atmospheric dread.
scene.dominant_visual_idea: A solitary operative in a rain-slicked industrial catwalk, steam erupting from overhead conduits, silhouettes cut by amber warning strobes.

important_generation_architecture.reason: Ensure high-motion action maintains anatomical and structural integrity; avoid dream-like morphing or floating limbs during fast walking.
important_generation_architecture.generative_boundaries: Generate the continuous atmospheric physical action via LTX-2.3. No 2D HUD overlays or neon text generation inside diffusion.

character.hair: Buzzcut with a wet hairline, rainwater dripping from jawline
character.wardrobe: Weathered matte-black ripstop tactical poncho over charcoal technical harness, fingerless grip gloves
character.performance: Urgent, athletic, low center of gravity, controlled breathing, head swiveling to check catwalk corners

environment.location: Upper industrial exhaust gantry of an orbital refinery
environment.architecture: Perforated steel catwalk grating with visible depths below, heavy rusted pneumatic pipes, rising white pressurized steam
environment.props: Rugged handheld diagnostic terminal secured to tactical chest rig with coiled cable, amber flashing emergency beacon in background

spatial_blocking.foreground: Bursting vertical plume of pressurized white steam on frame left with water droplets splashing on catwalk railing
spatial_blocking.midground: Vance advancing rapidly along the center catwalk axis, boots impacting wet perforated steel
spatial_blocking.background: Vast cavernous exhaust shaft plunging hundreds of meters, crisscrossed by yellow safety pipes and distant rotating ventilation fans
spatial_blocking.camera_relation: Low-angle reverse tracking shot at 0.9m height, maintaining 2.5m distance in front of subject as he advances

action_timeline.action: Vance strides purposefully forward through the wet catwalk, ducking his head slightly as an overhead pipe vents a violent hiss of white steam.
Water spray catches the side of his face; he wipes his brow with a gloved forearm without breaking his stride.
An amber emergency beacon on the wall flashes into rotation, casting a warm sweeping beam across his poncho and determined eyes.
He reaches down with his right hand, unholstering a magnetic cable clamp and slapping it onto the steel rail as he turns a corner.

performance.primary_subject: Vance's athletic weight, physical resistance against rain and wind, purposeful tactical momentum
performance.micro_actions: Heavy heel-to-toe footfalls, neck tensing against cold spray, jaw set in determination, quick scanning eye movements

camera.camera_type: Cinema camera mounted on high-speed stabilized tracking rig
camera.starting_position: Low-angle dynamic reverse-tracking medium shot in front of subject
camera.depth_of_field: Cinematic shallow depth of field rendering background fans and pipes in rich oval anamorphic bokeh
camera.focus_priority: Vance's face and chest rig, with crisp water droplet specular highlights

movement.00:35-00:39: Smooth backwards tracking at matching walking pace (1.4 m/s) keeping subject centered in frame
movement.00:39-00:41: Subtle deceleration and 20-degree pan following subject's turn into the junction

camera_path.start: 2.5m directly in front of subject on catwalk centerline
camera_path.middle: continuous linear reverse tracking matching subject velocity

visual_callback.thematic_contrast: The human pulse against relentless industrial machinery.
visual_callback.lighting_motif: The pulsing amber beacon rhythmically cutting through cool industrial darkness.

lighting.source: Flashing amber industrial beacon (2200K) combined with cool overhead mercury vapor catwalk tubes (6000K)
lighting.quality: High-contrast chiaroscuro with hard specular wet reflections and volumetric light shafts in steam
lighting.temperature: Split-tone: 2200K tungsten-amber strobe vs 6000K cold industrial blue-cyan ambient
lighting.direction: Flashing key light sweeping from rear-right to front-left, continuous cool backlight separating shoulders from deep background
lighting.subject_lighting: Dynamic amber edge highlights dancing across rain-wet poncho, deep transparent shadows on eye sockets
lighting.background_lighting: Silhouetted massive ventilation blades cutting through backlit steam plumes
lighting.important_rule: Light must interact realistically with airborne water vapor and reflective wet steel.

color_and_finish.grade: Kodak 2383 theatrical LUT with deep saturated blacks and rich amber-cyan separation
color_and_finish.contrast: Punchy filmic contrast with deep blacks and intense specular highlights
color_and_finish.saturation: Selective saturation: rich industrial amber and cyan against desaturated charcoal steel
color_and_finish.grain: Prominent, tactile organic 35mm motion picture grain
color_and_finish.halation: Vivid red-orange photonic halation blooming around the flashing amber beacon and wet steel reflections
color_and_finish.texture: Wet textured ripstop nylon, cold rusted iron, beaded water on human skin, dense atmospheric vapor

audio.acoustics_and_ambience: Vast industrial cavern acoustics with deep low-frequency ventilation rumble and reverberant metallic reflections.

ltx_2_3_prompt: In the cavernous industrial catwalk of an orbital refinery, a 32-year-old male technician in a wet matte-black ripstop poncho and tactical harness strides forward through cold rain and plumes of pressurized white steam erupting from rusty overhead pipes. Water drips from his jawline as his heavy combat boots rhythmically impact the wet perforated steel grating with resonant clangs; a sweeping amber emergency strobe flashes across the corridor, bathing his focused face and reflective nylon poncho in warm amber light against cool cyan shadows before he reaches down and locks a magnetic cable clamp onto the steel railing with a sharp metallic snap. The camera is locked into a low-angle 0.9-meter reverse tracking shot on a 35mm anamorphic prime lens, smoothly gliding backward at 1.4 m/s in front of the advancing technician with rock-solid stabilized inertia and creamy oval bokeh on the distant rotating ventilation fans. Split-tone lighting contrasts the 2200K rotating amber beacon with 6000K industrial background backlighting, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, striking red-orange halation around specular water highlights, tactile wet nylon and rusted iron textures, accompanied by resonant steel footfalls, rushing high-pressure steam, driving rain spray, and a dark pulsing analog bass synthesizer bed.

comfyui_direction.camera_strategy: Reverse tracking shot: 7m travel at 1.4 m/s at 0.9m height.
comfyui_direction.audio: Joint audio-visual latent generation synchronizing heavy boot clangs on steel with visual foot strikes and steam venting.
comfyui_direction.prompting: Emphasize physical weight, mechanical foley, optical anamorphic characteristics, and split-tone lighting.

render_strategy.pass_1_base: 640x268 @ 30 FPS, 181 frames (6s * 30 + 1), Euler sampler with 8-step ManualSigmas.
render_strategy.pass_2_refine: 1280x536 @ 30 FPS (2.39:1 aspect ratio), Euler sampler with 3-step ManualSigmas.

generation_priority: 1. Grounded physical foot-to-grate contact without sliding or rubber legs.
2. High-speed reverse camera tracking with stable horizon and smooth momentum.
3. Believable steam dynamics interacting with amber strobe lighting.
5. Tight audio synchronization of heavy metallic footfalls with visual steps.

quality_control.critical_story_test: Visceral tension and physical struggle against harsh industrial elements.
quality_control.critical_continuity_test: Catwalk grating, poncho wetness, and cable clamp must remain physically solid.
quality_control.critical_performance_test: Athletic forward momentum must feel heavy and human, never like a floating avatar.
quality_control.critical_camera_test: Tracking rig must maintain consistent distance without digital jitter.
failure_conditions: poncho textures look like smooth plastic
